points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 058801f clean build passed in network-disabled cfd-bench, 2 CPUs/3 GiB/256 pids, with explicit CFD_EXTERNALS_ROOT and EXTERNAL_ROOT pointing into /opt/external.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: README says --restart takes a manifest; main.cpp:120–133 instead appends _rankN.bin to its argument and silently proceeds on missing or size-mismatched files. It does not restore transient time/history.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Distinct CgnsReader, MeshBuilder, Partitioner, Physics, Residual, SteadySolver, TransientSolver and OutputManager components; major solver methods remain monolithic.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Source files inspected for generic finite-volume implementation; no copied CFD core identified. No exhaustive external similarity search performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp:74,89–109 reads case configuration and mesh path rather than dispatching on two mesh filenames. Case-conditioned numerical startup rules are separate.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS and neighbor halos exist, but main.cpp:89–109,136–156 retains full mesh on every rank through solver iterations. NACA np8 lift≈0.0303 differs materially from near-zero np1; the cylinder np8 result is a failed 200-step pilot.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Residual.cpp:40–48,114–115 falls back on nonpositive reconstructed states; missing or mismatched restart inputs are silently ignored in main.cpp:120–133 and divergent M2 metadata is marked successful.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: CMakeLists.txt and README contain no registered CTest or dedicated regression suite. Evaluator clean build succeeded; no production CFD rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Contestant checkpoint 8899f00 contains 3377 tracked solver/pylibs paths and 53 solver/build paths; curated result removes those artifacts. The manager curation itself is not charged as contestant misconduct.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Physics.hpp provides a four-variable 2-D compressible state, ideal-gas flux and constant-viscosity treatment; report.tex:60–123 describes governing equations.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CgnsReader.cpp:40–59,215–239 reads TRI_3/QUAD_4/BAR_2 in all zones of the first CGNS base; unknown/MIXED sections are skipped. MeshBuilder constructs geometry and adjacency.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Residual.cpp:31–72 assembles interior flux with opposite signs; :110–155 handles boundary and wall viscous contributions.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Physics.hpp:59 implements local Lax–Friedrichs/Rusanov flux; no higher-resolution Riemann solver credit is assumed.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Physics.hpp:115–182 implements farfield, slip and no-slip states; Residual.cpp:134–155 applies pressure-only inviscid and viscous no-slip wall fluxes.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Gradient.cpp:15–39 and Reconstruction.cpp:45–56 implement weighted LS face reconstruction. Final SteadySolver.cpp:92–105,139–145 delays M≥0.5 inviscid reconstruction beyond selected run lengths; historical binary is unbound.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Reconstruction.cpp:6–41 implements Barth limiting and Residual.cpp:40–48 falls back on nonpositive face states. Final-source long first-order startup and unbound historic binary limit production-order evidence.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: OutputManager.cpp:118–135 uses full viscous traction in force integration; :203–217 projects tangential shear for cf. Report.tex:595–598 acknowledges negative viscous drag. Surface boundary velocities are zero on no-slip at :190–194,224.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: SteadySolver.cpp and ImplicitSolver.cpp implement pseudo-time continuation and LU-SGS; selected M2 laminar diverged before supplied target.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Final TransientSolver.cpp:182–214 measures the inner ratio after adding pseudo-time regularization; selected Re200 residual history has 943 steps at 2000 iterations, above configured/metadata maximum1000. Historical binary attribution and actual strict full-residual misses remain unknown.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and neighbor halos exist, but main.cpp:89–109,136–156 retains full mesh on every rank through solver iterations. NACA np8 lift≈0.0303 differs materially from near-zero np1; the cylinder np8 result is a failed 200-step pilot.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Examiner validator independently passed all eight workspace case directories and report; structural conformance does not establish convergence, physical correctness or restart semantics.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Read-only examiner validate_outputs.py invocation passed all eight workspace case directories and report on 2026-10-30. It is a structural check only.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M2 laminar metadata marks converged despite report.tex:600–604 recording divergence at 1.55 orders; selected Re20 is a transient-labeled periodic result, not the required credible steady wake.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Selected Re20 Cd≈1160 and Re200 Cd≈2105/FFT St≈8.1 are physically implausible. Negative M015/M080 laminar viscous drag is disclosed. Three inviscid NACA cases are separately more credible.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: All 11 accepted PDF pages checked. Six NACA force plots are delivered in checkpoint 8899f00 but excluded from curated report; Re200 force plot compresses late lift/drag and cylinder contours are physically suspect.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report.tex:244 falsely denies full-mesh replication and :588–593 incorrectly attributes St≈8.1 frequency to coefficient amplitude scaling; report does disclose negative viscous drag and M2 laminar divergence.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Checkpoint 8899f00 preserves selected histories and standalone NACA force figures; curated report excludes those plots and raw data. Metadata revision null leaves exact historical binary unresolved.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable 058801f clean CMake build passed in network-disabled cfd-bench (2 CPUs, 3 GiB, 256 pids) with explicit /opt/external roots. README.md:33 calls --restart a manifest, but main.cpp:120–133 appends _rankN.bin to the supplied string and silently continues if absent or mismatched; no transient clock/history is restored.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CgnsReader.cpp:40–59,215–239 reads all zones in the first base and TRI_3/QUAD_4/BAR_2 sections, but skips CGNS MIXED sections; MeshBuilder builds geometry/adjacency. Full generality is limited.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Residual.cpp:31–72,110–155 reconstructs face states, assembles opposite face fluxes, and applies Rusanov and wall/farfield paths; Physics.hpp:59,115–182 contains the flux and boundary treatments.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Gradient.cpp:15–39 and Reconstruction.cpp:6–56 implement weighted LS and Barth limiter; Residual.cpp:40–48,114–115 falls back on nonpositive reconstructed state. Final SteadySolver.cpp:92–105,139–145 delays M≥0.5 inviscid reconstruction at least 5000 steps, while reported runs end earlier; exact historical binary is unbound and no convergence-order study is shown.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: OutputManager.cpp:118–135 integrates full viscous traction while :203–217 computes tangential cf; report.tex:595–598 acknowledges negative viscous drag sign. The pressure/viscous force split does not isolate tangential skin friction.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Final TransientSolver.cpp:182–214 adds pseudo-time regularization to the spatial+BDF residual before the stopping ratio, contrary to TASK.md:143 full transient residual definition. :40–44 raises max inner to at least 2000; selected checkpoint residuals contain 943 steps at 2000 despite metadata max=1000. Exact historical binary is unbound; strict full-residual misses cannot be reconstructed.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: Partitioner.cpp:63–78 calls METIS and broadcasts partition; MpiHalo.cpp uses neighbor sends/receives. main.cpp:89–109,136–156 retains full mesh on every rank during iteration. Report.tex:549–573 gives NACA np1 Cd0.000813/Cl−0.000028 vs np8 Cd0.000858/Cl0.0303, and cylinder np8 is only a failed 200-step pilot, not a consistent completed comparison.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Inviscid NACA cases have readable histories and plausible final Cd, but laminar force split includes negative viscous drag and M2 laminar diverged. Re20 Cd≈1160 is not a plausible steady force; Re200 Cd≈2105 and St≈8.1 are not credible shedding. NACA rank comparison exists; cylinder np8 is a 200-step failed pilot.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Report contains equations, contours and residuals but claims no full-mesh replication despite source, attributes an St≈8.1 frequency error to amplitude scaling, and omits standalone steady force plots from the curated report. All 11 accepted pages checked.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separate mesh, physics, flux, reconstruction, solver and output files provide modular seams; data and geometry remain 2-D and equation state uses four components.

flags.flag: metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful final results
flags.evidence: Checkpoint 8899f00 naca0012_m200_laminar_re5000 metadata marks completed=true, converged. Immutable report.tex:600–604 explicitly says residual diverged at 1.55 orders versus target3 and was declared converged by a relaxed 1.5-order fallback. Selected raw final400 steps 1941–2340 Cd decreases 0.1248758→0.1209758, while rhoE residual rises 0.000347273→0.000444171; neither supplied target nor a justified force plateau is established. Separately Re20 metadata calls a result statistically_periodic while Cd and Cl remain exactly constant over t=9.39–50. This does not establish force/residual synthesis; no rerun.

flags.flag: Full mesh or full state replicated on all MPI ranks during iterations
flags.evidence: Immutable 058801f and checkpoint 8899f00 share solver/src/main.cpp Git blob 77eae4fe67d9ce68227b6293367b8aac91132d68. main.cpp:89–97 declares GlobalMesh gm and reads the complete mesh on every rank; :104–109 builds local partitions but leaves gm alive; :136–156 invokes runSteady/runTransient in the same scope, without releasing gm. TASK.md prohibited shortcut 7 forbids per-rank full mesh replication during iterations. The selected metadata says full_mesh_replication_during_iterations=false and has git_revision=null; exact historical binary remains unbound. This is the task prohibition, distinct from numbered DQ9 full-state/geometric-only wording.
No internal existing CFD executable call found in inspected submitted source; no exhaustive external authorship search.
No direct evidence force/residual histories were generated without solving. Constant Re20 values and incorrect metadata do not by themselves prove synthetic histories.
Case-driven CGNS mesh input does not establish a two-filename-only branch.

NACA np1/8 Cd0.000813/0.000858 and Cl −0.000028/+0.0303 differ materially relative to near-zero lift, but absolute change is not order one and convergence states differ; cylinder np8 is a failed pilot.
Source contains implicit and transient methods, so explicit-only integration not established.
Major claimed algorithms exist; full traction versus tangential split is scored as defective output, not an absent algorithm. Exact historic binary remains unbound.
No specific report figure is proven unrelated to its submitted data; checkpoint figures and matching CSVs are documented with hashes.
METIS and partition-local solution exist. All-rank full mesh is charged separately as TASK prohibited shortcut 7, not inferred full-state/geometric-only DQ9.

Final source keeps M≥0.5 inviscid cases first order for at least 5000 steps while selected runs end earlier, but an older source used 100 steps and historic binary is unbound. No production-disabled claim is proven.
Output surface values use boundary wall velocity, so undocumented adjacent-cell no-slip failure is not established.
No specific named-variable swap found in examined figures.
No affirmative copied/wrapped open-source solver core found in inspected source; no exhaustive external authorship search.
